name: masonry-grid-framer
title: Masonry Grid (Framer Motion)
author: AlgorizeTech
description: A CSS-column masonry layout with staggered entrance animation. Use it for image galleries and card walls of uneven height.
docs: Framer Motion build of `masonry-grid` — same props, markup and install path; install one or the other. Named export: MasonryGrid. Generic over your item type — pass `items` and a `renderItem` callback. Column count and gaps come from `columnsClassName` and `gapClassName`, so responsive behaviour is plain Tailwind. CSS columns fill top-to-bottom per column, so visual order differs from DOM order.
